steps.action: Resample AAPL Alpaca 1-min bars to daily OHLCV and compute 10 core Bucket-48 daily features
steps.success_criteria: Daily DataFrame with 1,260 rows, columns: open/high/low/close/volume + body_pct, close_pos, atr14, rsi14, higher_high, higher_low, bull_control

steps.action: Walk-forward backtest daily RSI<30 mean reversion on AAPL: 2yr IS / 1yr OOS / 1yr step, hold 21 days
steps.success_criteria: WF report with n_trades, WR, PF, Ret% for 4 OOS folds; if WR≥52% and PF≥1.10, flag as promising

steps.action: Run cross-sectional decile-long/short backtest on 100 S&P 500 tickers using 21-day momentum
steps.success_criteria: CSV table: decile 1-10 returns, long-short Sharpe; if long-short Sharpe > 0.5, momentum signal survives in this universe

steps.action: Build a daily resample pipeline module that reads 1-min parquet and writes daily parquet for any ticker
steps.success_criteria: Module accepts ticker arg, reads 1-min parquet, writes daily parquet with closed='left' label='left' semantics, tested on 3 tickers

steps.action: Port the 10 Bucket-48 daily features into a reusable compute_all_daily_features(df) function
steps.success_criteria: Function exists, tested on daily AAPL, returns same df with 10 new float columns appended, no NaN after warm-up period

steps.action: Run daily RSI<30 strategy on MSFT and XOM to check cross-ticker replicability of the daily edge
steps.success_criteria: Both tickers produce WF reports with WR≥50%; at least one of the two has PF≥1.05 (not profitable but not negative)

steps.action: Test daily close<VWAP short-term reversal: long when close < 20-day SMA and RSI < 40, exit after +5% or 10 days
steps.success_criteria: WF output delivered; comparison table of RSI<30 vs SMA+RSI strategies shows which entry condition has higher PF

goals_addressed: Test daily-frequency hypothesis as the primary pivot from failed 5-min research
Generate first evidence of positive expected value at daily resolution
Build reusable daily pipeline before expanding across full S&P 500 universe
